The Explorers' Guildhall, also known as Ironforge Guildhall, is the headquarters of the Explorers' Guild. It is located in the Hall of Explorers within the dwarven city of Ironforge. "The newly completed Guildhall provides members with offices and meeting rooms, workshops to repair gear and equipment, warehouses and libraries, private quarters for higher-ranking members and group bunkrooms for newer initiates. A large museum open to the public shows exhibits of relics collected by the Guild; when titan artifacts are on display, the line to get into the museum often snakes out the entrance of the Guildhall and across the public square in front of the building."

The faction discount is a percentage discount when buying items based on reputation with the faction of a vendor. As of Patch 2.3, all vendors with an associated faction now give discounts at all levels above . * : 5% discount * : 10% discount * : 15% discount * : 20% discount This includes the riding skill below expert and mounts. In 3.2 the faction discount has been expanded to apply to flying mounts, through Thrallmar/Honor Hold reputations. As of World of Warcraft: Cataclysm, goblins always receive the best available discount, regardless of reputation. This means that you get a 20% discount even when at neutral reputation with a faction, despite normally only being applied at exalted rep

The Face Collector is an elemental creature featured in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone. The Blackwald's depths always harbored dangerous inhabitants, but now, the forest's curse calls them forth with a dirge only they can hear, and there are tales of shifting elementals who steal the faces of men. The witch's curse has brought many strange creatures to life. Many believe that the Face Collector is a swamp creature made powerful and sentient by Hagatha. There are rumors, however, that once he may have been a bounty hunter.

__NOTOC__ Ezul'aan is a draenei paladin trainer located in the Training Hall in Stormwind City. Following the Fourth War, and recognized as one of the foremost paladins in the realm, Ezul'aan takes care of sending promising paladins, who impressed him with their rapid progress, on missions. More particularly to allow them to obtain unique materials that can only be found in the cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest, so that Therum Deepforge can create weapons at the height of their dedication for them. Fall damage is environmental damage inflicted upon a player when they fall from a certain height. Death caused by fall damage causes the same 10% durability loss to equipment as a normal PvE death. Water does not cause any falling damage unless player hits the ground underwater, also if player is under some sort of water walking effects before submerging to water the damage will be caused as much as it would on normal ground. Fall damage no longer causes rogues to lose Stealth or druids to lose Prowl. In both cases (rogue, cat-form druid), the damage the character takes from falling is reduced; the distance these characters can fall without taking damage is greater than for other characters.

Farming in the original sense of the word means to do nothing but killing a certain type of monster for the express purpose of getting them to drop certain items. It is distinct from grinding experience, as monsters will continue to drop items regardless of the player's level. The term is also extended to include searching for ore and herbs, which does not have to involve killing mobs. "I farmed the murlocs on the coast for Slimy Murloc Scales for an hour last night." "I can't run a Heroic right now, I'm flying around Storm Peaks farming Saronite." The Farraki tribe or the Sandfury tribe (sometimes spelled Sand Fury), originally known as the Razorbranch tribe, is a tribe of sand trolls, located in the deserts of Southern Kalimdor. They practice blood magic to survive the harsh desert.

Farstrider Retreat is a small quest hub in Eversong Woods. The Farstriders who live here can always be counted upon to offer tasks to willing adventurers. The building is guarded by several Silvermoon Guardians.

Farstrider Enclave is a Farstriders base in the Ghostlands. It is located on the southern shore of Lake Elrendar, isolated from most of the rest of the friendly population of the Ghostlands. It is surrounded by Apparitions in the Lake, trolls of the Shadowpine tribe to the east and south and Lynxes on the land. The enclave was renovated in year 25. Halduron Brightwing and his Farstriders were present here when they noticed some strange happenings at Dawnstar Spire. They immediately rushed there only to find the Blood Knights and Lor'themar Theron fighting against Dar'Khan Drathir and his undead minions.

.18505, beta map of Draenor containing Farahlon in the upper right before it was removed.]] Farahlon (or Plains of Farahlon) is an island located in the northeast of alternate Draenor, on the Barrier Sea. In the main timeline, this was the area that was transformed into the Netherstorm in Outland. A Garrison mission involves sending followers in order to find Farahlon and understand where Netherstorm came from. .]] Fathom rays, bloatrays, sky rays, or waverays are large flying rays native to Nazjatar. Gasses naturally stored within the creatures allow them to survive within the depths, and those same gasses also allow them to effortlessly float through the air. These gasses originate from local corals that are part of the diet of the rays. The naga raise bloatrays in captivity, harvesting their gas organs to craft alchemy which allows them to breathe air more easily. Both the ankoans and the Unshackled use waverays as mounts.

]] Feign Death is a level 6 hunter ability. It causes the hunter to fall to the ground and pretend to be dead for up to 6 minutes. This clears the hunter's threat, leading mobs to either attack the next-highest target on their threat list or, if no other target is available, drop combat altogether. It also prevents nearby mobs from noticing the hunter as long as it remains active. Hunter pets can be commanded to feign death with Play Dead.
